title: Shopify store examples: one theme, five stores | Ultra
description:
One Shopify theme, five stores that look nothing alike. We tapped through the real demo stores of Ultra, one UTD theme with five presets:

• Grip — auto parts: compare products side by side
• Ultra — electronics: pick a version, see the stock count, add to cart
• Harbor — furniture: quick view with material and color swatches
• Sprout — toys: a free-shipping goal right in the cart
• Grace — jewelry: a shoppable lookbook and a gift add-on in the cart

Same theme underneath. You change the style, not the platform.

Ultra is $100 in the official Shopify Theme Store. Try it free, with no time limit; you pay only when you publish your store.
👉 https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd

Voiceover is AI-generated.
